customManagers.description: git-cliff pins: CLIFF_VERSION in the shared release workflows (release, release-publish) and in ci.yml's release-test step, each passed to scripts/release/install-git-cliff.sh, which verifies the release signature against a pinned key. One depName, so a bump moves every site in one PR, and the release tests run on the version the workflows install. The signing-key fingerprint lives in the script, never on a line this manager rewrites.
